steps.message: Create a timer with 10 hours, 9 minutes, and 25 seconds. Do not start the timer.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -Ei 'clock|alarm|deskclock'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -Ei 'clock|alarm|deskclock'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "cmd package query-content-providers --brief --user 0 | grep -i deskclock"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "cmd package query-content-providers --brief --user 0 | grep -i deskclock""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "am start -a android.intent.action.SET_TIMER -p com.google.android.deskclock --ei android.intent.extra.alarm.LENGTH 36565 --ez android.intent.extra.alarm.SKIP_UI false; dumpsys notification --noredact | grep -Ei 'deskclock|timer'"
